title: Projection residual of a + s'w for a ∈ Q
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π := Q.starProjection, and let a ∈ Q, w ∈ ℝ^P and s' ∈ ℝ with s' ≥ 0. Then |(a + s'w) − π(a + s'w)| ≤ s'|w|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a w : Euclid P) (s' : ℝ), a ∈ Q → 0 ≤ s' → ‖(a + s' • w) - Q.starProjection (a + s' • w)‖ ≤ s' * ‖w‖
